context: Audit this journal app and the supplied metadata-only Journal.xcarchive for iOS 27 engineering, design, and App Store readiness. Work offline, report first, and do not edit the app. Save Markdown, JSON, and HTML. The fixture contains bundle metadata rather than runnable executables; do not claim runtime validation.

checklist.name: Per-bundle archive gates
checklist.description: Inspects the supplied xcarchive directly. Identifies the widget SDK 25, Xcode 25 and deployment target 12 upload gates with its own plist evidence rather than borrowing the app values.

checklist.name: SDK-linked lifecycle migration
checklist.description: Finds the SDK 27 app with all four supported launch-screen keys absent. Verifies scene lifecycle manually, allowing dynamic configuration rather than treating a missing manifest alone as proof of failure. Does not predict an ITMS code.

checklist.name: Provider and privacy boundaries
checklist.description: Challenges the all-on-device and every-iPhone AI claims against the supplied PCC route and missing eligibility tests. Does not automatically apply third-party AI consent to Apple PCC; requires consent review for any real third-party fallback.

checklist.name: Dated rollout channels
checklist.description: Keeps the 27.2 beta ATT changes and October 23 Duo launch separate from current release gates; April 2027 Duo screenshots are future preparation, not a current blocker.

checklist.name: Design and marketing review
checklist.description: Includes scene-sized adaptive layout, accessibility, task continuity and approved/localized header/search assets with availability claims, marking unobserved UI and App Store Connect state manual.

checklist.name: Report contract
checklist.description: Produces Markdown, JSON and HTML with platform_review, bundled_reference and not_run. Keeps not_detected from becoming not_applicable or a pass and never invents a runtime result.

checklist.name: Evidence and boundaries
checklist.description: Keeps app files unchanged and policy dates explicit, records metadata-only archive limits, supplies a grouped fix plan, and invents neither credentials nor Apple employment.

checklist.name: Optional APIs and toolchain scope
checklist.description: Does not require every new API, confuse deployment with linked SDK, or claim Xcode 27 supports iOS 13 just because App Store Connect states that upload floor.
